description.en: Install software, prepare development environments, run projects, and manage files.
description.zh-CN: 安装软件、准备开发环境、运行项目与管理文件。

description.en: Inspect devices, diagnose applications, adjust networks, and perform system tasks.
description.zh-CN: 设备体检、应用诊断、网络调整与系统任务。

description.en: Diagnose common Linux, Debian, Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows problems.
description.zh-CN: 覆盖 Linux、Debian、Ubuntu、macOS 与 Windows 的常见问题。

description.en: Skills created or imported by the user; product updates never overwrite them.
description.zh-CN: 你创建或导入的个人能力；产品更新不会覆盖。

description.en: Choose native package managers and trusted sources for the target, and explain effects before installation.
description.zh-CN: 按目标系统选择原生包管理器和可信来源，安装前说明影响。

prompt.en: Help me install the software I need. Explain its source, dependencies, and effects first.
prompt.zh-CN: 帮我安装需要的软件，先说明来源、依赖和影响。

description.en: Install and verify Python, Node, Go SDKs, and common development CLIs.
description.zh-CN: 安装并验证 Python、Node、Go SDK 与常用开发 CLI。

prompt.en: Inspect the development environment this project needs and propose a preparation plan.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查这个项目需要的开发环境，并给出准备计划。

description.en: Use existing lockfiles and install npm, pip, uv, or Go dependencies in the intended environment.
description.zh-CN: 遵循项目已有锁文件，在隔离环境中安装 npm、pip、uv 或 Go 依赖。

prompt.en: Inspect and install this project's dependencies while preserving its existing lockfiles.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查并安装这个项目的依赖，保留现有锁文件。

description.en: Recognize Node, Python, or Go projects and run them with the selected SDK.
description.zh-CN: 识别已有 Node、Python 或 Go 项目，并使用所选 SDK 运行。

prompt.en: Inspect and run the current project, explaining the commands first.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查并运行当前项目，先说明会执行哪些命令。

description.en: Analyze space, large files, mounts, and persistence within bounded paths without deleting automatically.
description.zh-CN: 在限定路径中分析空间、大文件、挂载和持久性，不自动删除。

prompt.en: Analyze storage space and large files without deleting anything.
prompt.zh-CN: 分析存储空间和大文件，不要删除任何内容。

description.en: Inspect file, Git, Docker, and development download paths while preserving gateway and integrity evidence.
description.zh-CN: 检查文件、Git、Docker 和开发下载路径，并保留网关与校验证据。

prompt.en: Inspect why downloads are slow and explain safe acceleration options.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查下载慢的原因，并说明可用的安全加速方式。

description.en: Start with minimal read-only evidence about the system, disks, processes, services, and recent errors.
description.zh-CN: 从最小只读证据开始检查系统、磁盘、进程、服务和最近错误。

prompt.en: Inspect the iStoreOS runtime status without changing configuration.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 iStoreOS 的运行状态，不要修改配置。

description.en: Search iStore applications and diagnose installation failures from task logs, packages, and plugin capabilities.
description.zh-CN: 搜索 iStore 应用，安装失败时结合任务日志、包状态和插件能力定位原因。

prompt.en: Find suitable iStore applications and explain candidates and installation effects first.
prompt.zh-CN: 帮我查找适合的 iStore 应用，并先给出候选和安装影响。

description.en: Inspect init.d services, UCI enablement, and listening ports before confirmed changes.
description.zh-CN: 检查 init.d 服务、UCI 启用状态和监听端口，变更前明确确认。

prompt.en: Inspect why this service is not running and show a plan before changing it.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查这个服务为什么没有运行，修改前先告诉我计划。

description.en: Diagnose unreachable, 500, blank, or login-loop pages before restarting or reinstalling.
description.zh-CN: 处理打不开、500、空白或登录循环；先采证，重启或重装前确认。

prompt.en: Diagnose the LuCI management page problem with read-only checks first.
prompt.zh-CN: 诊断 LuCI 管理页面异常，先只读检查。

description.en: Inspect, install, start, stop, and diagnose Docker, dockerd, and containers.
description.zh-CN: 检查、安装、启停和排查 Docker、dockerd 与容器。

prompt.en: Inspect Docker status and problems without deleting containers or data.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 Docker 的状态和问题，先不要删除容器或数据。

description.en: Plan data_root migration after checking capacity, service effects, and rollback paths.
description.zh-CN: 规划并迁移 data_root，执行前核对空间、服务影响和回滚路径。

prompt.en: Analyze a Docker data-directory migration plan without executing it.
prompt.zh-CN: 分析 Docker 数据目录迁移方案，先不要执行。

description.en: Use KAIPlus Linkspace recovery points by default; keep full overlay backup as an explicit manual operation.
description.zh-CN: 默认使用 KAIPlus Linkspace 恢复点；overlay 全量备份仅作为明确的手动操作。

prompt.en: Inspect KAIPlus protection and create a recovery point only when one is not already active.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 KAIPlus 保护状态，仅在当前没有有效保护时创建恢复点。

description.en: Measure Internet, download paths, IPv4/IPv6, NAT, and LAN quality without changing the network.
description.zh-CN: 测量公网、下载路径、IPv4/IPv6、NAT 和局域网质量，不修改网络。

prompt.en: Inspect this device's network quality without changing configuration.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查这台设备的网络质量，不要修改配置。

title.zh-CN: 系统工具与升级后修复

description.en: Handle IPv6 modes, disk sleep, app-store, and kernel-module issues.
description.zh-CN: 处理 IPv6 模式、硬盘休眠、应用商店及内核模块问题。

prompt.en: Inspect how iStoreOS system tools can address this problem.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 iStoreOS 系统工具可以如何处理这个问题。

description.en: Verify source, architecture, and space; recommend backup and require explicit approval.
description.zh-CN: 执行前验证来源、架构和空间，提示备份并要求明确确认。

prompt.en: Check whether this .run file suits the current device without executing it.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查这个 .run 文件是否适合当前设备，先不要执行。

description.en: Read or adjust QuickStart features through the device control interface.
description.zh-CN: 通过设备控制接口读取或调整 QuickStart 功能。

prompt.en: Inspect the QuickStart features on this target.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 QuickStart 功能。

description.en: Inspect Internet, download paths, IPv4/IPv6, NAT, and LAN quality.
description.zh-CN: 检查公网、下载路径、IPv4/IPv6、NAT 与局域网质量。

prompt.en: Inspect Linux network quality without changing configuration.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 Linux 设备的网络质量，不要修改配置。

description.en: Inspect systemd, apt/dpkg, storage, processes, ports, and bounded service logs.
description.zh-CN: 检查 systemd、apt/dpkg、存储、进程、端口和限长服务日志。

prompt.en: Inspect the Debian system status.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 Debian 系统状态。

description.en: Inspect sources, phased updates, Snap, Netplan, cloud-init, and service failures.
description.zh-CN: 检查软件源、分阶段更新、Snap、Netplan、cloud-init 和服务失败。

prompt.en: Inspect Ubuntu updates and system status.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 Ubuntu 更新和系统状态。

description.en: Inspect version, architecture, uptime, disks, memory pressure, and launchd summaries.
description.zh-CN: 检查版本、架构、运行时间、磁盘、内存压力和 launchd 概况。

prompt.en: Inspect this Mac's system health.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 Mac 的系统健康状态。

description.en: Inspect one launchd job and bounded unified logs before proposing an operation.
description.zh-CN: 检查一个 launchd 任务和限长统一日志，操作前给出计划。

prompt.en: Inspect this macOS service and its recent logs.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查这个 macOS 服务和最近日志。

description.en: Inspect system facts, disks, service counts, and recent critical system events.
description.zh-CN: 检查系统、磁盘、服务总量和最近严重系统事件。

prompt.en: Inspect Windows system health.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查 Windows 系统健康状态。

description.en: Diagnose one service and recent system events; start, stop, or restart only after approval.
description.zh-CN: 诊断一个服务及最近系统事件，明确批准后才启停或重启。

prompt.en: Inspect this Windows service and its recent system events.
prompt.zh-CN: 检查这个 Windows 服务和最近系统事件。
